translation: AI-assisted translation (Claude Opus 5.5, 2026-11-15). Delivery, free-float and corporate-event inputs are not available locally; those entries are BLOCKED with the precise data requirement.

strategies.name: Volume Pocket Pivot (O'Neil/Kacher)
strategies.entry: close > open and volume > highest(iff(close < close[1], volume, 0), 10)[1]
assumptions: down day = close below the previous close; the 10 sessions are those before today

strategies.name: OBV Bearish Divergence
strategies.entry: high > high[$n] and obv < obv[$n]

strategies.name: Chaikin Oscillator Bullish Turn
strategies.entry: cross_above(ema(ad, 3), ema(ad, 10))

strategies.name: MFI Bullish Divergence
strategies.entry: low < low[$n] and mfi(14) > mfi(14)[$n]
assumptions: n is unspecified; tested values 5/10/20 chosen on the discovery segment only

strategies.name: VWAP Support Bounce
strategies.entry: all_of(close > vwap, 8)[1] and low <= vwap * 1.0015 and low >= vwap * 0.9985 and close > open
assumptions: '> 2 hours' = the previous 8 fifteen-minute bars closed above VWAP

strategies.name: Anchored VWAP Pullback from 52-Week Low
strategies.entry: low <= anchored_vwap(low == lowest(low, 252)) * 1.005 and close > anchored_vwap(low == lowest(low, 252))
assumptions: anchor = most recent bar whose low was the trailing 252-bar low; 'touches' = within 0.5%

strategies.name: Multi-Day VWAP Pinch
strategies.entry: cross_above(close, max(rvwap(5), sma(close, 20))) and volume > 1.5 * sma(volume, 20)
assumptions: VWAP_5D = 5-session rolling VWAP of the daily typical price (no intraday volume curve)

strategies.name: Volume Profile POC Breakout
strategies.entry: cross_above(close, vp_poc(60)) and volume > 1.5 * sma(volume, 20)
assumptions: daily volume profile: each session's volume assigned to its typical price, 24 price bins over 60 sessions (no intraday tick distribution)

strategies.name: Low Volume Node Fast Traverse
strategies.entry: vp_density(60) < $d and close > close[5]
assumptions: LVN = price bin holding < d x the POC bin's volume in the 60-session daily profile; Momentum(5) > 0 = close above close 5 bars ago

strategies.name: VROC Explosion
strategies.entry: roc(volume, 14) > 2.0 and close > open and (close - open) > atr(14)

strategies.name: Klinger Volume Oscillator Cross
strategies.entry: cross_above(kvo(34, 55), kvo_signal(34, 55, 13)) and close > ema(close, 50)

strategies.name: Ease of Movement Bullish Breakout
strategies.entry: cross_above(sma(eom(14), 14), 0)

strategies.name: Force Index 13 Zero Cross
strategies.entry: cross_above(force(13), 0)

strategies.name: NVI Smart Money Signal
strategies.entry: cross_above(nvi, ema(nvi, 255))

strategies.name: PVI Crowd Momentum
strategies.entry: cross_above(pvi, ema(pvi, 255)) and nvi > ema(nvi, 255)

strategies.name: Twiggs Money Flow Breakout
strategies.entry: cross_above(rma(((close - min(low, close[1])) - (max(high, close[1]) - close)) / (max(high, close[1]) - min(low, close[1])) * volume, 21) / rma(volume, 21), 0) and close > high[1]

strategies.name: Volume-Weighted MACD Cross
strategies.entry: cross_above(vwma(close, 12) - vwma(close, 26), ema(vwma(close, 12) - vwma(close, 26), 9))

strategies.name: Wyckoff Spring
strategies.entry: low < lowest(low, 20)[1] and close > lowest(low, 20)[1] and volume > 2 * sma(volume, 20)

strategies.name: Wyckoff Upthrust After Distribution (Short)
strategies.entry: high > highest(high, 20)[1] and close < highest(high, 20)[1] and volume > 2 * sma(volume, 20)

strategies.name: Stopping Volume Hammer
strategies.entry: falling(close, 5)[1] and volume > 2.5 * sma(volume, 20) and lower_wick > 2 * body
assumptions: 'Down trend for 5 bars' = 5 consecutive lower closes before the signal bar

strategies.name: Up/Down Volume Ratio Surge
strategies.entry: sum(iff(close > close[1], volume, 0), 50) / sum(iff(close < close[1], volume, 0), 50) > $r

strategies.name: Intraday Opening Volume Shock
strategies.entry: minute_of_session == 15 and volume > 0.30 * avg_day_volume(20) and close > session_open

strategies.name: Block/Bulk Deal Follow-Through
strategies.entry: volume[1] > 5 * sma(volume, 20)[1] and close > high[1]
assumptions: volume-spike proxy only; actual block/bulk deal records are not used

strategies.name: Intraday Intensity Index Surge
strategies.entry: sum((2 * close - high - low) / (high - low) * volume, 21) > 0

strategies.name: Intraday Intensity Index Zero Cross
strategies.entry: cross_above(sum((2 * close - high - low) / (high - low) * volume, 21), 0)
assumptions: event version: the 21-bar sum crosses above zero (A is the literal always-on state)
